title: In vivo passive lumbar axial twist stiffness in neutral and six flexion/extension postures (kneeling, thorax fixed)

quantity.name: axial twist secant stiffness (normalised to neutral)
quantity.definition: axial twist moment about L4/L5 at peak twist divided by peak twist angle (start-to-peak differences), each repeat; normalised to the neutral-posture value per session; posture normalised to max flexion/extension

source.sample: 10 healthy young males, no LBP in previous year, university population; tested in 2 sessions (morning/afternoon)

protocol.summary: Kneeling; upper body fixed by an adjustable rigid harness of padded wooden supports (thorax fixed), lower body fixed to a cradle resting on a frictionless table (2500 nylon ball bearings); a force couple via cables/pulleys rotated the lower body (pelvis) to the left until no further rotation with increasing moment (each trial <10 s, mean velocity 28.6 (8.1) deg/s). Axial twist moment computed about the centre of L4/L5 from a load cell; angles from Optotrak clusters on chest and pelvis (lumbar = pelvis vs thorax). Seven starting flexion-extension postures (FEP): neutral kneeling, mild/mid/max flexion, mild/mid/max extension (normalised to max flexion/extension; postures reached 93.2% max flexion and 93.4% max extension). Relaxed: instructed not to activate muscles; 14 EMG channels (bilateral RA, EO, IO, LD, thoracic and lumbar ES) monitored; kneeling effort <1% MVC. 3 trials per posture per session.
how_to_simulate: Model kneeling posture with thorax fixed and pelvis free to rotate axially (frictionless support), lumbar spine pre-set to the flexion/extension posture (fractions of the model's max flexion/extension; mild/mid/max)
Set all muscle activations to zero (passive tissues and passive muscle only)
Rotate the pelvis relative to the thorax (left axial twist) until the passive moment about L4/L5 reaches ~83 Nm (mean applied moment) and record the twist angle
Compute secant stiffness = moment / peak twist angle; normalise stiffness and angle to the neutral-posture values and compare per posture; compare coupled lateral bend
protocol.notes: Absolute neutral stiffness not reported; ratio of reported means 82.6 Nm / 39.4 deg ~ 2.1 Nm/deg (derived, approximate). Max-flexion value from text; other postures digitised from Fig 5.

extraction.from: Fig 5 (p.516) bars mean +- SD; Results text p.515
extraction.uncertainty: +-0.02 (fraction of neutral) for digitised bars and SDs; text values exact
extraction.check_notes: Bars digitised by pixel column scans against tick-label centres (pdftotext -bbox); check: max flexion digitised 0.823 vs text 0.810 (SD 0.164 vs 0.166); mean of max/mid extension digitised 1.265 vs text 1.254 -> systematic ~+0.01, within stated uncertainty; values rounded to 2 decimals.

pass_rule.rule: normalised stiffness within +-1 SD per posture; correct ordering (flexion < neutral < extension)
